title: Decision provider
description: An advisory classifier (decisions/<id>.yaml). It answers typed questions with probabilities and is never a harness, a seat or an authority: below the threshold, or unavailable, the caller falls back to its own behaviour.

then.description: A roster model asked through its CLI: model is a roster id, reached through that CLI's own login, so there is no endpoint, key or price list (the CLI reports what each turn cost).

kind.description: Which client speaks to the endpoint: jev (TypeSafe Jev, the default when absent), openai (the OpenAI Decisions API) or model (a verified roster model through its CLI, e.g. a Claude subscription). Which provider is ACTIVE is decisions/active.yaml's choice, not this field's.

effort.description: kind model only: the effort to ask the roster model at; one of its efforts.

credentialRef.description: Where the key is read from at each call (env:NAME or file:PATH, ~/ meaning the service user's home). The value is never stored, logged or recorded.
